info.name: MX Platform accounts ach return API

params.name: ach_return_guid
params.description: The unique identifier (`guid`) for the ACH return. Defined by MX.

items.docs:
:::warning
The features documented here are in a beta state, and this documentation is considered draft material subject to frequent change.
:::

Use this endpoint to get an ACH return by its `guid` or `id`.

params.name: institution_guid
params.description: The identifier for the institution associated with the ACH return. Defined by MX.

params.name: returned_at
params.description: The date and time when the return was reported by the Receiving Financial Depository Institution (RDFI) in ISO 8601 format without timestamp.

params.name: resolved_status_at
params.description: The date and time when the return was resolved by the Receiving Financial Depository Institution (RDFI) in ISO 8601 format without timestamp

params.name: return_code
params.description: The associated ACH return code and notice of change code. See [Return Codes](/api-reference/platform-api/reference/ach-return-fields#return-codes) for a complete list.

params.name: return_status
params.description: The status of the return. See [Return Statuses](/api-reference/platform-api/reference/ach-return-fields#return-status) for a complete list.

params.name: page
params.description: Results are paginated. Specify current page.

params.name: records_per_page
params.description: This specifies the number of records to be returned on each page. Defaults to `25`. The valid range is from `10` to `100`. If the value exceeds `100`, the default value of `25` will be used instead.
